title: skills(project): the platform catalog lists working calendars as shipped
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_

Fixes #35964
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:做应用的人(和他们的 AI)查「平台已经提供什么」这一页时,工作日历和节假日表现在列在「已提供」里,不再写着「不可用」。
- 为什么做:工作日历已经上线,这一页却还让人自己再建一套日历,属于工作日历技能交付的收尾。
- 出错会怎样:只是文档一页和一道评测题,写错了会误导应用作者,可以直接撤回,不影响运行中的系统。
- 要你做什么:这是对外发布的技能包,需要你合并或批准。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`: two object rows, `sys_work_calendar` and `sys_work_calendar_exception`, join the "Money, imports and approvals" table beside `sys_exchange_rate`, the precedent the calendar object itself names. The rows say what ships: kept per organization in Setup, read by an approval's `escalation.clock: 'working_time'`, open on the data API.
- The Planned row narrows to what is still missing: "Working-day formulas", not available, linked to ADR-0157. The page does not name the three functions, because a formula cannot call them yet.
- `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` is regenerated from that source (`gen:skill-refs`), not edited by hand.
- `skills/objectstack-project/evals/project-process.json` case 8 now expects the shipped answer: no `business_hours_calendar` or `holiday` object, the two platform objects named, the formula half still a missing capability marked `PLATFORM-CANDIDATE`, and `escalation.clock: 'working_time'` where the SLA is an approval deadline.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/skills` patch. `@objectstack/spec` takes none: `packages/spec/scripts/**` is not in that package's `files`.

**The hand-written ceiling is paid, not raised.** The page's hand-written text is capped at 1581 tokens (6324 bytes) and stood at 6321 bytes. The new rows cost 236 bytes, so five pieces of restated text were cut:

| Cut | Why it is restated |
|:--|:--|
| Banner: "the prose columns are authored beside the generator" | generator internals; nothing an app author acts on |
| Intro: ", not at the runtime" | the sentence already says `list_objects` hides system objects |
| Party row: ", with no platform party object" | the section is titled "Not owned by the platform" |
| Item row: "; the platform ships no item object" | same |
| Planned paragraph: "The PR that ships a row moves it into the tables above." | a rule for the framework PR, kept in the generator's doc comments; the app-side step is already objectstack-project §5 step 4 |

Result: 6322 bytes, 1581 tokens, at the ceiling. The ceiling constant and the test file are untouched.

**Read first** (by risk):
1. `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`, the two new rows and the Planned row: every claim on a published page.
2. The five cuts above, in the same file's `PROSE` and `NOT_PLATFORM_ROWS`.
3. Eval case 8 in `project-process.json`.

## Evals

Case 8 keeps its prompt. Its expected answer and assertions change: `must_contain` is now `sys_work_calendar` and `PLATFORM-CANDIDATE`; `must_not_contain` gains `name: 'business_hours_calendar'` and `name: 'holiday'`. No case was added or removed. The eval was not run against a model here.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs` prints `10 generated files in sync with packages/spec`.

Premise, measured on origin/main `7de1bad5cb`:
- `sys_work_calendar` and `sys_work_calendar_exception` are in `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE` (`platform-object-names.ts:106-107`) and in the Setup navigation (`setup-nav.contributions.ts:147-148`). Both objects set `apiEnabled: true` with no `apiMethods` restriction.
- `ApprovalEscalationSchema.clock` is `'wall_clock' | 'working_time'` (`approval.zod.ts`), and the approvals service calls the calendar service's `addWorkingHours`.
- The three D4 functions exist as TypeScript exports of `@objectstack/formula` but are not registered in the formula language: 0 hits in `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts` and `cel-engine.ts`; control `daysBetween|addDays` hits 7 and 4 lines there.

<details><summary>Readings on head 7e7af399fb</summary>

- Net added lines: +8 (31 added, 23 deleted, 4 files, changeset included; budget 40).
- Generator test, under the verify lock: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 20 passed (20)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Hand-written text: 6321 -> 6322 bytes, 1581 -> 1581 tokens, ceiling 1581.
- Generated page: 10671 -> 10855 bytes, 2668 -> 2714 tokens, 155 -> 154 lines (generator-owned, measured, not ratcheted).
- Eval fixture: 10167 -> 10558 bytes, 156 -> 158 lines (measured, not ratcheted).
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exit 0: authored 197404 -> 197404 of 202541; whole shipped tree 288105 -> 288249.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 76 commands; all 76 were started (`--ran`: 76 derived, 0 UNRUN). 71 exited 0. `check:doc-formula-expressions` exited 3 (prerequisite) and exited 0 after building the lint closure under the lock. The other four are the next line.
- NOT MEASURED, left to CI: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. Each exits 3 asking for a full build, and reads built output this diff does not change.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The rows sit under "Money, imports and approvals" without renaming the group: a title change costs bytes under the same ceiling.
- The Planned link is ADR-0157, the accepted contract, in place of the design issue the old row pointed at.
- The row does not teach `escalation.calendar` or the organization default; the automation skill owns that.
